pullRequests.title: feat(frontbin): match 29 functions and fix native source selection
pullRequests.author: DameNavarro
pullRequests.head: match/frontbin
pullRequests.body:
Add 26 shared PAL/NTSC-U frontbin implementations and three NTSC-U-only
implementations, adapted from the NTSC decomp drafts under GPL-3.0.
Preserve existing file compiler flags, required file-scope symbol-size
hints, and fixed-address global accesses. Fix native C exclusion from
the PAL object fallback. Retire integrated drafts, document four
unfinished attempts, and refresh declarations and progress records.
Merged current master and verified:

All three PAL core programs: MATCH with retail…
